newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Resolute in Gawler exploration j/v.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Resolute in Gawler exploration j/v.

text.p: Resolute Resources Ltd said it and Dominion Gold Operations Ltd had reached a joint venture agreement with the Maralinga Tjarutja people to explore on 5,000 square kilometres of ground in the Gawler Craton.
This was the first joint venture agreement entered into by the Maralinga people for exploration on their freehold land, Resolute said in a statement.

The land lay immediately adjacent to the Gawler joint venture tenements containing the Challenger deposit, discovered by Resolute and Dominion, and was considered by the Maralinga joint venturers to be one of the most prospective areas within
the South Australian region, it said.

Under the agreement, MT Mining Pty Ltd, a Maralinga Tjarutja company, would have a 10 percent free carried interest until decision to mine, while Resolute was manager of the project and would share 90 percent equity with Dominion, it said.

If MT Mining elected to participate in development of a mine, it must contribute its share of development costs and Resolute and Dominion are to be reimbursed the carried expenditure and interest from MT's share of production.

Resolute director of operations Phil Lockyer said the South Australian mines department had advised the granting of tenements was imminent and field exploration would begin as soon as the necessary Aboriginal site clearances had been undertaken.
